entries.title: Dobbins for Tuten: the paperwork survived the judgement
entries.summary: Leslie receives J.K. Dobbins. Heather receives Bhayshul Tuten. Sleeper marks the trade complete; both sides have exchanged players, and the Oracle has retained the right to be unbearable about it.
entries.verdict: It is difficult to accept stupidity in others, but the trade desk has let this one through. Leslie gets Dobbins; Heather gets Tuten; The Oracle gets two managers to quote back to themselves later. Everyone receives something.

entries.title: Brock Bowers for Tre Tucker?
entries.summary: The reported Brock Bowers-for-Tre Tucker offer was rejected. The managers remain unnamed; the audacity has waived its right to anonymity.
entries.verdict: A trade calculator requested a wellness check. Fortunately, someone at the receiving end still had access to the word no.
